purpose: Uppercase underlined text link followed by a chevron; on hover the underline collapses to the right and the chevron draws itself in.

patterns.hover: underline scaleX 1 -> 0 (0.8s quint-in-out, origin right); chevron stroke draws 0 -> 100% (0.4s sine-out) starting 0.3s before the underline ends; mouse leave reverses
